about: Youth allowlist for co_scraper.py. The Colorado health department (CDPHE) find-and-compare dashboard covers every health-licensed facility, adult and youth. Only facilities listed here with scope "in" are scraped; "unsure" waits for the owner and is not scraped; a facility of one of the listed types that this file does not name is reported at the end of a run and not scraped. Keyed by the dashboard's Facility ID. Reasons marked 'its own program list' come from the facility's public website, not from the state.
